posts.title: PostgreSQL Scripting Tips
posts.description: I have been working on a double-entry ledger implementation in PostgreSQL called pgledger, and I wanted to write some example scripts. pgledger is written in SQL and meant to be used from any language or platform where you can call SQL functions, so I wanted the examples to be pure SQL.
